217604.description:
For plain little Nina, working as a maid in the house of Count Mirkwood is her whole world—until a false accusation has her swept out on the streets. Jobless and with nowhere left to turn, Nina decides to set out on her very first solo journey. But Nina isn't just any maid—she's a supermaid! Her talents quickly prove indispensable to the people she meets during her travels. There's Emily, a mage who can't use magic; Astrid, a brilliant inventor whose experiments never quite work; and Tien, an orphan who can't seem to keep a meal down. Meanwhile, back at the Mirkwood household, things go awry in Nina's absence...

None of them realize it yet, but Nina might just be the answer they've all been searching for. Because when this supermaid is on the job, no mess can stand in her way!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

Ra-On can’t stand men, and he’s determined to stay away from them at all costs. Little does he know that the shy, soft-spoken Seo-U is crushing on him hard. So hard, in fact, that he’s recruited his more confident twin brother, Je-U, to act as his double and approach Ra-On. 217070.description:
The second cour of Futsutsuka na Akujo de wa Gozaimasu ga: Suuguu Chouso Torikae Den.

Through the actions of Reirin and Keigetsu, the series of disturbances caused by a curse in the inner court have settled down.
Through their swap, Reirin and Keigetsu learned of each other’s character, and a friendship was budding between the two of them.

Seasons pass, and we are now at early autumn. The location of the ritual where the Crown Prince and the Maidens wish for a bountiful harvest (the Harvest Festival) has been set within the southern lands ruled by the Shu clan. With no consort as guardian, Keigetsu arduously continues with preparations despite feeling the pressure as the host of the Harvest Festival. Meanwhile, Reirin is wholeheartedly supporting Keigetsu while being thrilled about her first royal outing.

However, right upon arrival, an unforeseen accident occurs and the ritual is interrupted. An agitated Keigetsu’s spell runs out of control, and she once again swaps bodies with Reirin. On top of that, among all the confusion, the post-swap Reirin is abducted...!?

Reirin’s two overprotective brothers Kou Keikou and Kou Keishou get involved and the situation heads in an unexpected direction.
Who is the new mastermind who is sneaking up in order to frame Keigetsu...?

The gratifying tale of switched fates brought to you by two girls who are polar opposites—the curtain rises on the second act, "The First Royal Outing" Arc!

(Source: Official Site)

A special commemorating the 30th anniversary of the anime series.

As a new 10,000-yen banknote featuring the Touto Tower design is issued and the nation is swept up in excitement, Conan and the Junior Detective League, accompanied by Professor Agasa, Ran, and Sonoko, visit the Nagano factory of the Japan Banknote Printing Bureau.

Meanwhile, counterfeit money is discovered at the scene of a murder in Tokyo, prompting the Metropolitan Police Department to establish an investigation headquarters. As the unprecedented circulation of counterfeit new banknotes throws the public into confusion, Conan and Heiji head to Osaka, where the counterfeit money is believed to have been printed.

217009.description:
Based on the erotic game by Jitaku Studio.

Hatsune Nijo’s tastes were thoroughly warped by the influence of a childhood friend’s mother, leaving him with an intense obsession with gyaru (gal) fashion and culture. Years later, Hatsune’s fixation had only deepened—to the point where he began cross-dressing to embody his ideal gyaru persona himself. Then, one day, he received a message from his younger sister, Tsukune Nijo: "Hey, Big Bro! So, my school recently started allowing students to wear casual clothes..." "If you're still into that whole 'gal' thing, why not come to school with me?" There was no curing this twisted obsession of his. So, he decided to simply embrace it and live life on his own terms! With that resolve, Hatsune returned to his hometown and decided to transfer into the school. A new school life begins—one spent alongside gyaru girls who fully accept and celebrate his cross-dressing alter ego!

(Source: Pinkpineapple, translated)

217629.description:
After being confined to Qingshan Mental Hospital, the gifted young man Chen Ji kills the enemy who killed his parents. He then accidentally travels back in time to the ancient world and becomes an apprentice at the Ning Dynasty Medical Clinic. Involved in a case involving the Secret Service, he becomes a non-staff member of the agency, only to discover he's also a spy for the enemy nation. The story revolves around this dual identity. Trapped in the maelstrom of power, Chen Ji secretly fights for survival, using modern knowledge to deconstruct spiritual cultivation systems and maneuvering to overturn the chessboard. Ultimately, he transforms from pawn to master, wielding the Qingshan Mountains as his blade, vowing to shatter the hypocrisy of heaven!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

217630.description:
"My name is Yang Jian, and by the time you read this, I'll be dead."

Ordinary student Yang Jian is caught up in a bizarre invasion, acquiring parchment from the future and a mysterious eye, becoming a ghost wielder. Yang Jian and his classmates escape the campus, but the crisis is just beginning. In this sinister world, the human world is a prison. The price of peering into darkness is eternal loss amidst endless wonder.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

217457.description:
Hizashi Hiruno, a freshman at a super-elite high school, has just finished his first academic proficiency test of the year. He anxiously awaits the results, which will set the tone for his next three years at school. But due to a mistake on his answer sheet, he receives an abysmal score and gets sent to remedial lessons! If there's one silver lining, he's not the only one—and his comrade could be the girl of his dreams?!

(Source: Yen Press)
